observation.command: cd /workspace && docker compose exec -T backend wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/v1/swagger.json -O /tmp/swagger.json 2>&1; docker cp workspace-backend-1:/tmp/swagger.json /tmp/swagger.json 2>/dev/null; wc -c /tmp/swagger.json 2>/dev/null; grep -oE '"/[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+"' /tmp/swagger.json 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -80
